Specification: This module is a small proof-oriented TLA+ module for properties related to sequence extensions. It extends FiniteSets, Sequences, SequencesExt, Naturals, Integers, and TLAPS, and contains a single trivial theorem asserting TRUE proved with OBVIOUS. It has no constants, variables, actions, temporal formulas, assumptions, or PlusCal content.
